name: Brazil
overview:
For about four weeks every four years, Brazil is at the forefront of everyone’s consciousness. But when they’re not playing jogo bonito, Brazil almost flies under the radar and that’s a real shame because it is a remarkable country and culture.  

When you visit, make sure to be always close to the water. Only then can you soak in the magic of the rivers of the Amazon, the falls of Iguazu, and the beaches of Rio de Janeiro.

seo.description: “Gracias! Sorry, obrigado!”, I tell a Brazilian immigration officer. Portuguese and Spanish are similar enough to create confidence and different enough to punish it.
